title: Project dashboard rollups
productBrief: A product lead wants a dashboard that rolls task status, blockers, and recent decisions up from individual project notes into one current view.
expectedStructuralObservations: Dashboard values are derived from underlying notes and decisions.
The system needs evidence for when a rollup was last refreshed.
scriptedUserNotes: If the source note changes, the dashboard should not silently stay stale.
Recent decisions should show where they came from.

deferredExpectations.graph: Later graph fixtures should capture source-to-view derivation edges and evidence anchors.
deferredExpectations.coherence: Later coherence checks should flag stale projections when source facts change.
